title: Cover the worker 08 WebView pages audit report with a change packet
summary: Adds change-control coverage for the existing worker-08 review-only WebView pages audit report, which was written without a packet and was failing strict worktree coverage.
reason: Every other function/module audit worker report has its own docs packet (for example MP-CHANGE-2026-0611-001 for worker-01). The worker-08 report was left uncovered, so mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed for every session sharing this worktree.
behavior_before: docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md existed in the worktree but was not listed in files_touched of any unreleased change packet, so strict coverage validation failed.
behavior_after: The worker-08 WebView pages audit report is covered by this packet and strict coverage validation no longer flags it.
manual_validation: Test-Path docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md -> True; first line '# Worker Review: worker-08-webview-pages'.

apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage -> worker-08-webview-pages.md no longer listed as uncovered.
rollback_plan: Delete this change packet; the worker-08 report itself belongs to the audit session that authored it.
notes: Coverage-only packet created during the objective-quality-verification review session (MP-CHANGE-2026-0611-202 review follow-up). The report content was authored by the function/module audit worker-08 session and is not modified here.
